chunks.DOC-ASTHMA: Asthma is a chronic inflammatory airway disorder that may cause episodic wheezing, cough, and shortness of breath.
chunks.DOC-DIABETES: Type 2 diabetes mellitus is characterized by hyperglycemia related to insulin resistance and impaired insulin secretion.
chunks.DOC-HTN: Hypertension is persistently elevated arterial blood pressure and is an important cardiovascular risk factor.
chunks.DOC-HYPOTHYROID: Hypothyroidism is reduced thyroid hormone activity and may present with fatigue, cold intolerance, and weight gain.
chunks.DOC-MIGRAINE: Migraine is a recurrent headache disorder that can include nausea and sensitivity to light or sound.
chunks.DOC-UTI: A urinary tract infection can cause dysuria, urinary frequency, and urgency, and is commonly caused by bacteria.
